title: Telemetry freshness — _rumlog (seconds since last event)
sqlTemplate: select extract(epoch from now()) - max(_timestamp) / 1000000.0 as freshness_seconds from _rumlog where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}}
emptyDataSemantics: No matching records in the query window -> max(_timestamp) is SQL NULL -> freshness_seconds is NULL -> NO_DATA (freshness undefined), never rendered as age 0.
